assumptions.admission: Runtime separately enforces occupied/reserved target slots, total inside goods and six boxes per inbound port.
assumptions.continuous: Independent exponential interarrival per slot after random initial phase; minimum 1 second.
assumptions.deadline: Manhattan reference plus 108m deadhead at 0.8m/s, 22s handling and configurable slack; not guaranteed fleet feasibility.
assumptions.duration: At most one day for unchanged day1 validator; no hidden multi-day time wrapping.
assumptions.hotspot: Nearest physical 20% of active slots have faster turnover; total demand is not matched to uniform.
assumptions.peak: Monotone compression of periodic release times into three waves within this duration.
assumptions.reference_plan: Each slot strictly alternates OUT/IN with unique inbound goods; release order is a reference plan, not runtime completion.
assumptions.uniform: Independent fixed phase per slot, periodic releases.

coverage_remap.experiment_role: separate coverage workload, not original-CSV same-input control

migration.hotspot_location_labels: source labels retained as provenance; reclassify spatial regions using new coordinates
migration.reference_deadline: original timestamps unchanged; runtime feasibility requires fresh validation

profile_role: runtime-assumption metadata only; no charge decisions in CSV
source: synthetic warehouse boundary tasks; LaDe-like seven fields, NOT actual Jilin records
